keys.name: Model keys
keys.what: Your keys for AI model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic and others). Agents and graders use them to call models; the provider bills you.

secrets.name: Secrets
secrets.what: Values your agent's tools need while a run is going, such as a web search key. Model provider keys do not go here.

tokens.name: Access tokens
tokens.what: Tokens that let your own scripts, CI and the SDK call Heimdall as you. Most people do not need one.
tokens.who: Your scripts, CI and the SDK

runners.name: Worker tokens
runners.what: Where your runs execute: the shared worker, a cloud sandbox (Daytona, E2B, Modal), or your own machine. The tokens here only connect a worker.

models.secretsHint: Keys your agent's tools need, such as a web search key, are Secrets, not model keys.
models.testFor: Test {{name}}, a paid call of about $0.001
models.testTitle: A test sends one small paid call to the provider, about $0.001.
models.unlocks: Leave Allowed models empty to unlock every {{provider}} model in the price list ({{count}}), for example {{first3}}.
models.unlocksAny: Leave Allowed models empty to unlock every {{provider}} model.
models.storageHint: Stored encrypted. Only the last 4 characters are shown again. Every member of this organization can run evaluations with it; only admins can change or delete it.
models.budgetHint: 0 means no limit. At the limit, runs on this key stop and the key shows 'over budget' until the 1st of next month (UTC).
models.unavailableAdmin: This server cannot save API keys yet. Admin: set HEIMDALL_MASTER_KEY and restart (see the hosting guide).
models.unavailableViewer: This server cannot save API keys yet. The person who runs this server can turn it on.
models.keyMissing: No working {{provider}} key. Add one in Settings > Model keys.

secrets.confirmRotate: Replace the value of {{name}}? Runs that start after this use the new value; the old one cannot be recovered.
secrets.description: Values are encrypted and can never be read back, only replaced.

tokens.description: A token can do only what its role and scope allow. Send it in the Authorization: Bearer header to the API at /api/v1.
tokens.neverExpires: A token that never expires is risky if it leaks.

usage.definition: Spend: what the model calls for this organization's work cost, priced from the price list, counted on the day of the call, UTC.
usage.costHint: Priced from the price list. Runs on the shared key included.
usage.keys: Charged to your keys this month
usage.keysHint: What your key budgets count. Includes judges and authoring jobs.
usage.keySpent: Charged to this key this month

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: You have changes on this page that are not saved. They are lost if you leave.

retention.confirm_one: Delete comparisons older than {{count}} day now? Comparisons and their runs older than that are deleted. This cannot be undone.
retention.confirm_other: Delete comparisons older than {{count}} days now? Comparisons and their runs older than that are deleted. This cannot be undone.

org.dangerBody: These settings delete data. Each one asks before it does.

kill.stateOn: New runs are stopped for every organization. Runs already going finish.
kill.confirmOff: Allow new runs on the whole server again? Queued runs start at once.

audit.pageOnly: Filters apply to the page in view.
audit.noMatch: No entries on this page match the filters.
audit.onlyReads: This page has only reads. Include reads to see them.

members.inviteValid: The link works once and expires
